title: A color clue, not a photo

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: In this schematic, the dark marks stand for preserved structures being compared with a reference. Such evidence can constrain some color hypotheses, but preservation and interpretation limit what is known about the whole animal.

misconception: A local pigment clue establishes the exact appearance of an entire animal.
objective: A fossil preserves structures interpreted as pigment-bearing organelles. What can this evidence do for a color reconstruction?
